# Spike results: `s09-20261103-cache-r2`

Variant: snapshot-only build (BUILD_ID dNnaqKFz2LVNu852ivEIc) identical to the r1/r2 build except lib/invitation/public.ts, where loadPublicInvitation is wrapped in React cache() so generateMetadata and the page share ONE loader call per request; product files unchanged. Round 2 of 2 (same server process as round 1, no platform contention).

Latency = k6 `http_req_duration` of the measured operation only (ms). CPU = % of ONE core, mean over the sampled run (host has the core count shown under Host). RSS = max MB of the server process group. "Platform" = the hosting platform's own `next dev` on the same host. Host busy includes every process. KiB/req = bytes received (headers + body, uncompressed; no Accept-Encoding sent) over all requests of the run, because k6 v0.54 does not tag `data_received` per request; the next RSVP run includes its one setup GET. Rows marked FAILED have no numbers by design.
